structured_summary: The robot delivers a package to a user in a quiet office, announces the delivery via speech, expects the user to acknowledge (by speech or head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement, and then provides a final speech confirmation within 1 second after receiving the acknowledgment.

obligations.source_sentence: The robot should announce the delivery via speech.
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: Consequences if the user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds
